Ek aisa raakshas,
jise Bhagwan Shiv ne khud amar jaisi shakti de di...
lekin vardaan milte hi usne sabse pehle Mahadev ko hi maarne ki koshish ki!
Aakhir kaun tha ye raakshas,
aur kaise usi ke vardaan ne uski jaan le li?
Is raakshas ka naam tha Bhasmasur.
Woh Bhagwan Shiv ka bahut bada bhakt tha.
Unhe prasann karne ke liye usne kathor tapasya ki.
Aakhirkaar,
uski tapasya se prasann hokar Bhagwan Shiv uske saamne prakat hue
aur use vardaan maangne ko kaha.
Bhasmasur ne ek aisa khatarnaak vardaan maanga,
jise sunkar koi bhi hairaan reh jaaye.
Usne maanga
ki woh jiske bhi sir par apna haath rakhega,
woh turant jalkar bhasm ho jaayega.
Bhagwan Shiv ne uski ichchha poori kar di
aur use yeh shakti de di.
Lekin vardaan milte hi Bhasmasur ki neeyat badal gayi.
Woh apni shakti ka istemaal Bhagwan Shiv par hi karna chahta tha!
Apni jaan bachaane ke liye Bhagwan Shiv wahaan se nikal pade.
Ab samasya yeh thi
ki Bhasmasur ko rokna behad mushkil tha,
kyunki uske paas khud Mahadev ka diya hua vardaan tha.
Tabhi Bhagwan Vishnu ne is sankat ko samaapt karne ke liye Mohini ka roop dhaaran kiya.
Mohini ke roop ko dekhkar Bhasmasur mohit ho gaya.
Mohini ne nritya karna shuru kiya aur Bhasmasur bhi unki nakal karte hue naachne laga.
Nritya karte-karte Mohini ne apna haath apne sir par rakha.
Bhasmasur ne bhi bina soche-samjhe unki nakal ki
aur apna haath apne hi sir par rakh liya!
Aur agle hi pal,
apne hi vardaan ki wajah se woh jalkar bhasm ho gaya.
Jis shakti ko paakar woh khud ko ajey samajhne laga tha,
wahi uski maut ka kaaran ban gayi.
Is kahaani se ek baat seekhne ko milti hai...
shakti se bada hota hai vivek,
kyunki bina vivek ke mili taakat insaan ke vinaash ka kaaran bhi ban sakti hai.
